sn11.15:1.2: Then Sakka, lord of the devas, approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, stood to one side, and said to him:
sn11.15:1.3: “Venerable sir, what is a delightful place?”
sn11.15:2.1: The Blessed One: “Shrines in parks and woodland shrines,
sn11.15:2.3: These are not worth a sixteenth part
sn11.15:3.2: In a valley or on the plain—
